summary: Iteration 8 (category-scoped search + low-stock alerts) tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass — category_id now expands to full subtree ($in) so a MAIN id returns all leaf products; scoped search (category_id + search) stays within subtree; /api/admin/stats returns low_stock + low_stock_threshold; /api/admin/low-stock returns {threshold, products[]} sorted asc; PUT /api/settings low_stock_threshold persists and recomputes low_stock. Frontend: header search dropdown (header-search-category) lists 'Toutes catég.' + 13 mains, empty search with category still navigates to /catalogue?category_id=..., catalog title reflects the category label (e.g. 'Recherche : "crème" · Visage'). Admin dashboard shows stat-low-stock card (red '1 Stock bas (≤ 5)'), clicking it opens Produits pre-filtered; products-low-stock-badge shows count on Produits tab; admin-filter-low-stock toggle filters table; low-stock-{id} row markers render. Settings set-low-stock-threshold input saves via 'Enregistrer les paramètres' and stats recompute (verified 5→15→5 round-trip). Baseline verified restored: 13 mains / 104 products / low_stock=0.

ui_bugs.issue: Section title is 'Vous aimerez aussi' but the review request specifies 'Produits similaires'. Minor label mismatch — code at /app/frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx:187.

integration_issues.issue: Race condition: ProductDetail's useEffect computes the sub-category scope via getAncestors(category_id) *immediately* on mount, but the CategoriesContext still loads /api/categories asynchronously. On a hard reload of /produit/{id}, categories are empty at that moment → getAncestors returns [] → scope falls back to the LEAF category id → related products only include the exact leaf's siblings (in our test case: Eucerin Bandages Advanced showed only 1 related product instead of 3 that share the Orthopédie sub-category). Fix: either await categories readiness (e.g. also depend on categories/flat in the useEffect deps and refetch related once available) or ask the backend for the parent category server-side.

action_items: Fix ProductDetail related-products race: recompute scope once CategoriesContext.flat is populated (add categories to useEffect deps, or resolve ancestors server-side).
(Spec alignment) Rename related section heading from 'Vous aimerez aussi' to 'Produits similaires' if the intent per the review_request is that exact label.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1609 lines — refactor into routers still overdue (>700-line guideline).
GET /api/admin/low-stock has no limit query param and hard-codes .to_list(500); fine at current scale but should paginate for growth.

PUT /api/products/{id} requires the FULL product body (name+price+stock+…). This makes partial updates (like just changing stock) awkward for API consumers — consider PATCH or making body fields optional. The admin UI works around it by sending the whole product on save.

CategoriesContext.getAncestors is a stale-closure hazard when called inside effects that don't depend on `flat` (see ProductDetail bug). Either memoize/expose a ready flag, or resolve category paths on the backend.

Related-products endpoint reuse of GET /products?category_id= is fine, but the frontend does the excluding-current-item locally with .slice(0,4); the API supports limit=9 then trims — small waste of bandwidth, ok.

rca of the issue: Related-products race: ProductDetail.jsx:89-101 useEffect depends only on [id]. It calls getAncestors(category_id) from CategoriesContext, but CategoriesContext.refresh() runs its own useEffect on mount and populates categories asynchronously. On a fresh navigation to /produit/{id}, both effects mount concurrently and the product effect wins the race → getAncestors returns [] because `flat` is still []. Consequence: `scope` falls back to r.data.category_id (the leaf), and the related API returns only the leaf's own products. Reproduction: hard refresh of /produit/6a8399a0fd8830baee58e7a4 → Orthopédie has 4 products (across Bandages+Attelles leaves), sub-category-scoped API returns 4, related list should show 3, actual = 1. Mitigation: (a) add `flat` (or `categories`) to the useEffect dep array and re-issue the related fetch once ancestors resolve; or (b) return category ancestry/parent in GET /api/products/{id} response so the frontend doesn't need the context to be ready.
